What HealthEquity says to expect

  • Fiscal year ending January 2027: revenues and net incomeFor the fiscal year ending January 31, 2027, management is raising guidance and now expects revenues of $1.411 billion to $1.421 billion. Its outlook for net income is between $242 million and $248 million, resulting in net income of $2.88 to $2.96 per diluted share.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
